description: pipeline listing is page/per_page envelope-paginated — mark it so result_info is delivered (consumer-proven). It pages by number: page/per_page in, result_info { count, page, per_page, total_count } and results out (https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/pipelines/methods/list/, read 2026-11-07), so it takes page mode like listV1Pipeline. Without a mode, .pages() fell through to token pagination and died before any request.
